title: Burst balloons
pattern: interval DP: choose the LAST action
statement: Bursting balloon i earns nums[left] · nums[i] · nums[right], where left and right are its current neighbours (missing neighbours count as 1). Return the maximum total for bursting all of them.
hints: Choosing the first balloon to burst makes the two sides interact (their neighbours change).
Choose the LAST balloon k to burst in an open interval (i, j): at that moment its neighbours are exactly i and j.

solution.explanation: The famous trick of interval DP: pick the last event, not the first. If k is the last balloon burst strictly between i and j, the two sides (i, k) and (k, j) are independent, since k shields them from each other, and k's reward is a[i]·a[k]·a[j]. dp over intervals by increasing length.
